query_parsed: List some slang terms for male genitals.

penis
: the standard anatomical term
dick
: very common, vulgar
cock
: common, strongly vulgar
junk
: informal, milder
package
: informal, euphemistic
balls
: specifically the testicles
nuts
: informal for the testicles
dong
: slang, somewhat humorous
schlong
: slang, often comic or exaggerated
willy
: childish or British informal
member
: euphemistic
manhood
: euphemistic, old-fashioned
shaft
: slang, usually referring to the penis
tool
: slang, often crude
pecker
: slang, somewhat old-fashioned or humorous
